recognize_zh: 高倍下多數淋巴樣細胞核有深的切跡或裂溝，呈咖啡豆或臀狀（cleaved nuclei），細胞質稀少，染色質中度濃縮，是濾泡性淋巴瘤中心細胞在骨髓抹片的典型樣貌。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells with scant pale-blue cytoplasm
Nuclei with deep clefts, notches, and indentations producing cleaved or buttock-like shapes
Moderately condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
A plasma cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm at left and a dark, densely stained tailed cell in the center
Scattered red cells; no normal myeloid maturation in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a population of small to medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and prominently cleaved, notched nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. An occasional plasma cell and a densely stained, possibly degenerated cell are also present. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell nuclei are irregular but usually less deeply cleaved, and the tumor is CD5+ cyclin D1+ rather than CD10+ BCL6+.
Marginal zone cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with more abundant pale cytoplasm and are CD10-negative.
T-cell lymphoma cells show cerebriform or flower-shaped nuclei rather than single deep clefts and express T-cell markers.
